title: Icon #9 Milestone DC Comics 1994 Shadow War Crossover Direct Sales Edition
conditionDescription: Three copies available; all in a similar Very Good range with clean glossy covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos.
descriptionText:
Icon #9 (January 1994, Milestone Media / DC Comics) -- Shadow War crossover chapter, "The Big Bang Was Just the Beginning..." Dwayne McDuffie's Icon from the Milestone line. Direct sales edition. Cover price $1.50 US.

Condition: Three copies available; all in a similar Very Good range with clean glossy covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copies being sold.
